batches.title: Batch 2 · Winter markets to 2027
batches.summary: Nine posts for December built on this season’s Instagram formats: winter-market moments, split screens, tiny-text POVs, rankings, saveable checklists and a year-end “Wrapped”. Set in a Calgary winter.

trends.name: Holiday and winter-market season
trends.why: Holiday sounds took over Reels right after Halloween. Shoppers plan gifts and outings on social media through December.
trends.used_in: weeks 4–5, set at winter markets with snow and “−20°” jokes

trends.name: Split-screen comparisons
trends.why: “Two ways” and before/after splits are among the formats trackers list this month.

trends.name: Tiny-text POV Reels
trends.why: Lo-fi, text-led, relatable Reels. One survey says half of users prefer unpolished Reels over highly produced ones.

trends.name: Rankings and listicles
trends.why: “Ranking X, worst to best” gets comments because people argue with the order.

trends.name: Saveable carousels
trends.why: Carousels lead on saves and shares. Since April 2026 Instagram favours original carousels and photos, not just Reels.

trends.name: “Send this to…” hooks
trends.why: Shares and DM sends now weigh heavily in reaching people who don’t follow you.

trends.name: Year-end “Wrapped” recaps
trends.why: Every December, brands copy the yearly-recap format. Bold stat cards, one number per slide.

trends.name: New Year resolution memes
trends.why: “Realistic edition” resolution lists come back every year between Christmas and January 1.

batches.sources_note: Trend data comes from third-party trackers (Nov 2026) and changes weekly.
notes: The Dec 14 and Dec 16 posts show low-stock and sold-out features. Move them later if those aren’t live for vendors yet.
Wrapped figures are illustrative and labelled so on the images and in the caption.
